title: Shard / hybrid orchestration
question: How does `mini-agent-rs orchestrate` split one coding task across parallel executors and still pass the build gate?
summary: A hub in plain code (no planner model) scopes the files the task names, builds ONE parent session (repo + task) and starts one executor per file. Each executor is a copy of that session plus an order for its own file. Every call is hedged: if it is slow, a twin starts and the first good answer wins. A plain-code check doubts suspicious answers. Files are written as answers land, then gofmt and the gate run, and fix waves repair only the files the gate blames.
source: agent-rs/src at perf/hybrid-shard-clones 062b27f (PR #96); shard core merged in #94 and #95

process: Reads the tracked files and the model config, and sets text_only.

nodes.label: scope()

attributes.name: subjects
attributes.description: MenuList.tsx -> {menu}: tokens that pair with ≥2 others (list) are suffixes

attributes.name: excluded
attributes.description: Words of sentences that say keep / unchanged / do not touch

responsibilities: Target = path quoted in the task, or its subject is a task word
No match → every file; gate blames fill gaps
process: want = task tokens − excluded tokens.
A file is a target when the task quotes its path or one of its subject tokens is in want.
Every file stays in the prompt as context; only the executors are scoped (t09: 20 → 4 executors).

nodes.label: Parent session
nodes.summary: Built once and copied into every executor

attributes.name: [0] system
attributes.description: "lead engineer … executors that are copies of this session apply the change"

attributes.name: [1] user
attributes.description: Every tracked file (dump), then the task

attributes.name: [2] assistant?
attributes.description: Only when the task spells no contract

operations.name: spells_contract(task)
operations.description: true if the task has `code`, { or a quote

responsibilities: Identical bytes for every clone → provider prompt cache hits
process: session = [system, user(repo + task)].
If the task does not spell its contract, one call writes it (names, signatures, JSON tags, status codes) and the answer is appended.
The session is wrapped in an Arc and shared by every clone thread.

attributes.name: MAX_RUN
attributes.description: A 15-file run missed a file in 7 of 8 calls

attributes.name: size(f)
attributes.description: Per-file answer overhead floor

process: Path order keeps a layer together (all types/*.ts, all components).
Runs close when the accumulated size passes total/inflight or MAX_RUN files.

nodes.label: hedged()
nodes.summary: Twin calls race; the first good answer wins

attributes.name: MAX_CALLS
attributes.description: First call + twins per unit

attributes.name: lat
attributes.description: Answer latencies of this wave

attributes.name: FIX_HEDGE
attributes.description: Hedge for fix waves

operations.name: threshold(lat, wave_n, hedge)
operations.description: hedge until ¼ of the wave answered (min 3), then 2× median, clamped to [1.5 s, hedge]

operations.name: hedged(call, file, hedge, lat, wave_n, slots)

responsibilities: Beat provider tail latency (a 150-token answer taking 20 s)
A failed or doubted call starts a new copy at once
process: Acquires a slot and starts call k = 0.
Polls every 250 ms or less; when the newest call is older than threshold() and a slot is free, starts a twin.
Ok → records latency and returns; Err (including doubted) → starts another copy, until MAX_CALLS.
Abandoned calls just release their slot when they finish.

nodes.label: Clone executor (call k)

attributes.name: edits
attributes.description: k == 0 and file > EDITS_ABOVE (600 B): answer SEARCH/REPLACE; twins answer the whole file

attributes.name: call_cfg(k)
attributes.description: GLM: thinking disabled, text_only = no_tools; twins (k>0) get twin_kwargs

responsibilities: Do not investigate, plan or review: execute the order
Use the task's names literally (<E>s = name + s)
process: Copies the session and appends the order for its file(s), with a Note when a previous copy was doubted.
One file: edits (first call, file > 600 B) or <<<FILE … FILE>>>; several files: one block or `UNCHANGED <path>` per file.
An edit that does not apply is an Err, and the hedge answers it with a whole-file twin.

nodes.label: Model provider

attributes.name: rate limit
attributes.description: Above that: 429 code 1302

attributes.name: retry wait
attributes.description: So parallel calls never retry in lockstep

operations.name: text_only(body)
operations.description: models/wire.rs:78 — tool_choice none, or no tool list

process: Retries 429/5xx with a jittered exponential wait, capped by MINI_AGENT_RETRY_MAX_WAIT.
The shared session prefix is cached by the provider: repeated clones mostly pay for the order and the answer.

nodes.label: doubt()

attributes.name: CHECKED
attributes.description: Only the first 5 copies must pass; later ones are taken as they come

attributes.name: need
attributes.description: JSON message literals the task quotes for this file

responsibilities: UNCHANGED for a scoped file whose layer the task names → confirm with another copy
Dropped quoted literal → re-ask with the reason as a Note
process: A doubt is returned as Err("doubted: …"), so hedged() starts the next copy, whose order carries the reason.
A wrong doubt never stalls a file: after CHECKED copies, answers are accepted.
